key.name: ocr-command
key.description:
Path to the executable used to recognise text in the selected area.
The program is invoked as `<command> --quiet <image.png>` and must print the recognised text to standard output. Exit code 0 means success, 2 means "the image was fine but contained no text", and anything else is treated as a failure (the last line of stderr is shown to the user).
When empty, the extension looks for the companion project's client in a few known locations (~/PrtScOCR/bin/ocr and ~/WaylandOCR/bin/ocr) and uses the first one that exists and is executable.
